full_prompt_en: A square, black-and-white silent-film-like image shows two people seated beneath a large tree beside still water. The tree trunk rises in heavy shadow along the left edge, and a web of fine hanging branches spreads over the upper half of the frame. Beyond them, a pale misty background softens the far bank until it is almost indistinguishable from the sky. The water occupies much of the right and lower distance, carrying a bright irregular reflection near the shore. On the sloping dark bank at lower left, a man in a brimmed hat and long dark coat leans toward a young woman. He is mostly in profile, his face pale enough to separate from the hat and shoulder. The woman sits just to his right in a dark sleeveless dress with a light neckline and short dark hair. She tips her face upward to look at him, while one arm appears braced near her side. Their legs and clothing blend with the shaded ground and small leaves around them. The bank runs diagonally down toward the water on the right, making the seated figures seem tucked beneath the enclosing branches. The image has pronounced grain and slightly soft edges, with the near tree and clothing forming dense black shapes while distant foliage dissolves into gray. Light comes from the open water and foggy background, backlighting the pair and placing their faces in gentle partial shade. There are no visible signs or readable words. The overall composition feels intimate and dreamlike, with a dark foreground sheltering a small exchange against a luminous, nearly empty distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带默片气息的黑白画面呈现两个人坐在一棵大树下的静水旁。粗树干沿左边缘在重影中升起，细密垂枝像网一样铺过上半画幅。枝条之后，浅色薄雾柔化远岸，使它几乎与天空难以分开。水面占据右侧及下方远处大部，在靠岸处带一道不规则的亮反光。左下斜坡状暗岸上，一位戴宽檐帽、穿深色长外套的男子向一位年轻女子倾身。他大多呈侧面，浅亮的脸足以从帽子和肩膀中分出。女子坐在他右边，穿深色无袖裙，领口较浅，短发深色。她仰脸看他，一只手臂似乎支在身侧。两人的腿与衣物同阴影地面及周围小叶片混在一起。岸边斜向右侧水面下降，使坐着的人像藏在包围他们的枝条下。图像有明显颗粒，边缘略柔，近处树木与衣服形成浓黑形体，远方树叶则消融成灰色。光来自开阔水面和雾蒙蒙的背景，从背后照着两人，让面孔留在柔和的部分阴影中。画面没有标牌或可读文字。整体构图亲密而如梦，深色前景庇护一段小小的交流，背景则明亮、近乎空旷。
style_prompt_en: The image has the finish of an aged monochrome film frame, with visible grain, deep foreground blacks, and a pale fog-filled distance. Fine irregular lines hang over broad quiet tonal fields, making the upper edge intricate while the far space stays open. Near silhouettes remain firm, but their internal detail merges into shadow; distant shapes soften almost entirely into gray atmosphere. A diagonal dark base guides the eye toward a bright reflective patch and gives the scene depth without sharp perspective. Backlight from an open pale area rims selected edges and leaves the nearest surfaces subdued. The overall effect is intimate and dreamlike, using low detail, organic framing, and a strong dark-to-light transition.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有陈旧黑白电影单帧的完成感，能看见颗粒、深黑前景和浅色雾中的远方。细密不规则线条悬在宽阔安静的色调区域上，使上缘繁复，远处空间保持开阔。近处剪影较坚实，但内部细节融入阴影；远方形状几乎全被灰色空气柔化。斜向深色基底引导视线至一块明亮反光，并在没有锐利透视的情况下建立纵深。来自开阔浅色区域的逆光勾亮少数边缘，使最近的表面保持低沉。整体效果亲密而如梦，依靠低细节、有机框景及强烈的明暗过渡形成。
theme_en: A misty black-and-white lakeside scene with two people seated beneath a tree
theme_zh: 两人坐在树下湖边的薄雾黑白场景
name: F.W. Murnau
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
